name: meads
description: Meads browser frontend and GitHub OAuth broker

scripts.build:wasm: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o meads.wasm ./wasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" wasm_exec.js
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/worker.js && node --check app.js && node --check github-auth.js && node --check github.js
